QUESTION_S012_19: HOW MANY INDEPENDENT DEGREES OF FREEDOM DO THESE EXPERTS REALLY CONTAIN?
ANSWER: Nearly all of them, at every level tested.

cross_expert_within_layer.reading: the 64 experts span ~62.9 of 64 possible directions -- near-orthogonal. A basis of R=57 captures only 90% of variance and costs 14.25 bits/weight equivalent, far worse than the 2-3 bits/weight quantization already achieves.

cross_layer.reading: expert 0's gate_proj across all 26 MoE layers is also near-independent. Layers do not repeat one computation.

within_expert.reading: a single expert matrix is itself high-rank. A rank-794 factorisation costs 15.23 bits/weight and a rank-1216 one costs 23.32 -- MORE than storing the matrix densely at 16 bits. Low-rank is not a saving here at any useful fidelity.

WHY_THIS_IS_A_DIFFERENT_CLAIM_FROM_THE_E: The existing provenance killed expert SIMILARITY -- whether experts resemble each other pairwise, under optimal permutation, and in function space. This measures whether they span a low-dimensional SUBSPACE, which mutually dissimilar vectors can still do. They do not. The two results agree and the second is stronger: the experts are not merely dissimilar, they are close to maximally independent.
CONSEQUENCE_FOR_O003: The expert organ has essentially NO exploitable linear structure. Shared basis, cross-layer sharing and low-rank factorisation are all refuted by measurement rather than assumption, joining clustering, common-delta, alignment, function-sharing and entropy coding from the earlier provenance, and PQ from today's Scar.
WHAT_REMAINS_UNREFUTED: Only NON-LINEAR structure: generated coefficients, procedural reconstruction, router-conditioned representation. The linear probes say nothing about those, and they are materially harder to build. For this specimen the parent tensors may be close to linearly minimal -- which would mean a Noetic win here must be non-linear, or must accept a capability loss the gate currently refuses.
COST: Three spectra, about five minutes total, against a multi-hour build of a shared-basis NR that the first spectrum would have doomed. S012 §7: cheapest causal discriminator first.

TRANSFERABLE_PRIOR_G031.claim: an MoE expert organ may be near-full-rank across experts, across layers, and within each expert matrix
TRANSFERABLE_PRIOR_G031.test_on_next_MoE: run the same three spectra FIRST, before any representation search. If the next specimen shows lower participation ratios, sharing is live there and O003 is the outlier; if it shows the same, this becomes an architecture-family prior and every sharing class can be skipped on sight.
